frictions.description: Filament v3 uses Livewire for login form submission (AJAX), not standard HTML form POST. curl POST to /login returns 405 Method Not Allowed, making it impossible to test the POST /login -> 302 redirect flow via curl alone.
frictions.resolution: Verified login page renders correctly via GET (200) and confirmed Livewire component mounts properly with email/password fields. PHPUnit tests for login are pre-existing failures (SQLite migration issue) documented in AGENTS.md as to-ignore.
